lead: The options are one verb in several forms (submit, submits, submitted, will submit). After a word of request, advice or necessity plus that, the verb takes the base form, whatever the subject.
選項是同一個動詞的幾種形式（submit、submits、submitted、will submit）。表示要求、建議或必要的字加上 that 之後，動詞用原形，不管主詞是誰。
steps: Look before that for a verb, adjective or noun of request, advice, demand or necessity.
看 that 前面，有沒有表示要求、建議、堅持或必要的動詞、形容詞或名詞。
If there is one, choose the base form, even after a singular subject such as every employee.
有的話就選原形，即使主詞是 every employee 這種單數。
For a passive, choose be + past participle. For a negative, choose not + base form.
被動選 be + 過去分詞，否定選 not + 原形。

head: Verbs that call for the base form
要求用原形的動詞
body: request, require, recommend, suggest, insist, ask, demand, propose, urge, advise. In the that-clause, the verb stays in the base form for every subject and every tense.
request、require、recommend、suggest、insist、ask、demand、propose、urge、advise。that 子句的動詞不管主詞和時態，都用原形。
ex: The manager requested that every employee submit the form by Friday.
經理要求每位員工在星期五前提交表格。
The consultant recommended that the company hire more engineers.
顧問建議公司聘請更多工程師。

head: Adjectives: essential, vital, necessary
形容詞：essential、vital、necessary
body: It is essential / necessary / important / imperative / vital / critical that … works the same way: the that-clause takes the base form.
It is essential / necessary / important / imperative / vital / critical that … 也一樣：that 子句用原形。
ex: It is essential that the client receive the documents today.
客戶今天一定要收到文件。
It is important that all visitors wear a badge at all times.
所有訪客都必須隨時配戴識別證。

head: Nouns: recommendation, request, requirement
名詞：recommendation、request、requirement
body: Nouns with the same meaning also call for the base form when that follows them: recommendation, request, requirement, suggestion, demand.
意思相同的名詞，後面接 that 時也用原形：recommendation、request、requirement、suggestion、demand。
ex: The recommendation that the office remain open on weekends was accepted.
辦公室週末照常營業的建議被採納了。
The requirement that each applicant provide two references is clearly stated.
每位申請人都要提供兩封推薦信，這項要求寫得很清楚。

head: Passive and negative forms
被動與否定的形式
body: Passive: be + past participle. Negative: put not before the base form, with no do or does.
被動用 be + 過去分詞。否定把 not 放在原形前面，不加 do 或 does。
ex: Our policy requires that each order be checked twice.
我們的規定要求每筆訂單都要檢查兩次。
The board suggested that the plan not be approved until the budget is final.
董事會建議預算確定之前先不要核准這個計畫。

head: British variant with should
英式用法：加 should
body: British English often keeps should: that every employee should submit. The meaning is the same. The bare base form is the usual American choice. should is followed by the base form too.
英式英文常在前面加 should：that every employee should submit，意思相同。美式英文常用不加 should 的原形。should 後面當然也是原形。
ex: British: The manager requested that every employee should submit the form by Friday.
英式：經理要求每位員工在星期五前提交表格。
British: It is essential that the client should receive the documents today.
英式：客戶今天一定要收到文件。

head: When the base form is not used
不用原形的情況
body: suggest meaning 'show' and insist meaning 'state as true' only report a fact. The verb then takes its normal tense and agreement.
suggest 表示「顯示」、insist 表示「堅稱是事實」時，只是陳述事實。動詞用一般的時態和單複數變化。
ex: The report suggests that demand is rising.
報告顯示需求正在上升。
He insisted that he had sent the email.
他堅稱自己已經寄出那封電子郵件。

pairs.right: We ask that each guest check out by 11 a.m.
pairs.wrong: We ask that each guest checks out by 11 a.m.
why: ask that calls for the base form, even after the singular each guest.
ask that 後面用原形，即使主詞是單數的 each guest。

pairs.right: It is vital that the report be finished today.
pairs.wrong: It is vital that the report is finished today.
why: vital expresses necessity, so the passive becomes be finished.
vital 表示必要，被動要用 be finished。

pairs.right: The data suggests that sales are falling.
pairs.wrong: The data suggests that sales be falling.
why: Here suggests means 'shows', so it reports a fact and uses a normal tense.
這裡的 suggests 是「顯示」的意思，只陳述事實，所以用一般時態。

head: Typical patterns
常見句型
items: insist that the fee be waived

traps: The options often put the base form next to the -s form. A singular subject pulls you toward -s, but after a request word the base form is correct.
選項常把原形和 -s 形式放在一起。單數主詞會讓人想選 -s，但在要求類的字之後，原形才對。
Do not match the tense of the main verb. requested is past, yet the that-clause still takes submit, not submitted or will submit.
不要配合主要動詞的時態。requested 是過去式，但 that 子句仍用 submit，不是 submitted 或 will submit。
Decide by meaning. The same verb gives a base form when it asks for action and a normal tense when it reports a fact.
用句意判斷。同一個動詞，要求行動時用原形，陳述事實時用一般時態。
